name: Bifang Mumian
source: Wu Minghui and his younger sister Wu Jiali live in Mumian Island by their owm since their parents died in an plane accident five years ago and their elder sister works in another city. However, they are still optimistic and enjoy the school life with their friends Zeng Feng, Xu Ruixia and a transfer student from UK named Yu Lijie. With time going by, Minghui gradually realizes the secrets of Ruixia and Lijie by chance. Meanwhile, the brother-sister relationship between Minghui and Jiali changes a little.
translation: 五年前，父母因飞机事故去世，吴明辉和妹妹吴佳丽从此独自生活在木棉岛，姐姐则在另一座城市工作。尽管如此，两人依旧乐观，和朋友曾锋、徐瑞霞，以及来自英国的转校生余丽洁一起享受校园生活。随着时间推移，明辉偶然发现了瑞霞与丽洁的秘密。与此同时，明辉和佳丽之间的兄妹关系也发生了一点变化。
